content: Web push in a React PWA: register a service worker, generate VAPID keys, subscribe via registration.pushManager.subscribe (request permission only after a user gesture), store the subscription in a Supabase push_subscriptions table keyed by user_id, and send from a Supabase Edge Function using web-push@3 with VAPID details. Handle push + notificationclick in the service worker. iOS requires the PWA installed via Add to Home Screen and HTTPS. Prune subscriptions on 404/410. Supabase also documents FCM/Expo alternatives for native apps.
